9.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- إِنَ هُوداً قَدِ انْتَصَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مِنْ أَعْدَائِهِ بِالرِّیحِ وَ انْتَصَرَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ (مِنْ أَعْدَائِهِ بِالرِّیحِ یَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ إِذْ أَرْسَلَ عَلَیْهِمْ رِیحاً تُدِیرُ الْحَصَی وَ جُنُوداً لَمْ یَرَوْهَا قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی یا أَیُّهَا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا اذْکُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَیْکُمْ إِذْ جاءَتْکُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنا عَلَیْهِمْ رِیحاً وَ جُنُوداً لَمْ تَرَوْها.
9.fa: امام علی (- همانا هود (به یاری خداوند از دشمنان خویش با باد سخت انتقام گرفت و خداوند متعال در جنگ خندق با طوفان و لشکرهای دیگری که آن‌ها را نمی‌دیدند، پیامبر (را یاری داد. بادی که گرد باد شن و خاک برانگیخت و خداوند متعال خود دراین‌باره می‌فرماید: یا أَیُّهَا الَّذینَ آمَنُوا اذْکُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَیْکُمْ إِذْ جاءَتْکُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنا عَلَیْهِمْ ریحاً وَ جُنُوداً لَمْ تَرَوْها.
9.en: Verily, God granted victory to Hud over his enemies by means of the wind, and He granted victory to Muhammad (over his enemies by means of the wind on the Day of the Trench (al-Khandaq), when He sent against them a wind that scattered pebbles and hosts whom they did not see. God the Exalted says: "O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see."
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 58

9.ar: الحسین (- الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ (أَنَّ یَهُودِیّاً مِنْ یَهُودِ الشَّامِ وَ أَحْبَارِهِمْ کَانَ قَدْ قَرَأَ التَّوْرَاةَ وَ الْإِنْجِیلَ وَ الزَّبُورَ وَ صُحُفَ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ (وَ عَرَفَ دَلَائِلَهُمْ جَاءَ إِلَی مَجْلِسٍ فِیهِ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ فِیهِمْ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (وَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ (وَ أَبُومَعْبَدٍ الْجُهَنِیُّ فَقَالَ یَا أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ (مَا تَرَکْتُمْ لِنَبِیٍّ (دَرَجَةً وَ لَا لِمُرْسَلٍ فَضِیلَةً إِلَّا نَحَلْتُمُوهَا نَبِیَّکُمْ فَهَلْ تُجِیبُونِی عَمَّا أَسْأَلُکُمْ عَنْهُ فَکَاعَ الْقَوْمُ عَنْهُ فَقَالَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (نَعَمْ مَا أَعْطَی اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ نَبِیّاً دَرَجَةً وَ لَا مُرْسَلًا فَضِیلَةً إِلَّا وَ قَدْ جَمَعَهَا لِمُحَمَّدٍ (وَ زَادَ مُحَمَّداً (عَلَی الْأَنْبِیَاءِ (أَضْعَافاً مُضَاعَفَةً ... قَالَ لَهُ الْیَهُودِیُّ فَإِنَّ هَذَا هُودٌ قَدِ انْتَصَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مِنْ أَعْدَائِهِ بِالرِّیحِ فَهَلْ فَعَلَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ (شَیْئاً مِنْ هَذَا قَالَ لَهُ عَلِیٌّ (لَقَدْ کَانَ کَذَلِکَ وَ مُحَمَّدٌ (أُعْطِیَ مَا هُوَ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ هَذَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ ذِکْرُهُ انْتَصَرَ لَهُ مِنْ أَعْدَائِهِ بِالرِّیحِ یَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ إِذْ أَرْسَلَ عَلَیْهِمْ رِیحاً تَذْرُو الْحَصَی وَ جُنُوداً لَمْ یَرَوْهَا فَزَادَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی مُحَمَّداً (عَلَی هُودٍ بِثَمَانِیَةِ آلَافِ مَلَکٍ وَ فَضَّلَهُ عَلَی هُودٍ بِأَنَّ رِیحَ عَادٍ رِیحُ سَخَطٍ وَ رِیحَ مُحَمَّدٍ (رِیحُ رَحْمَةٍ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی یا أَیُّهَا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا اذْکُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَیْکُمْ إِذْ جاءَتْکُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنا عَلَیْهِمْ رِیحاً وَ جُنُوداً لَمْ تَرَوْها.
9.fa: امام حسین (- از امام حسین (روایت است که فرمود: «یکی از یهودیان اهل شام و از علمای آنان، تورات، انجیل، زبور و کتاب‌های پیامبران را خوانده بود و دلایل آنان را می‌شناخت. وی به مجلسی آمد که یاران پیامبر اکرم (از جمله علی (ابن‌عبّاس (ابن‌مسعود و ابوسعید جُهنی در آن بودند. عالم یهودی به یاران پیامبر (گفت: «ای امّت محمّد (! شما تمام درجات پیامبران و همه‌ی فضایل رسولان را به پیامبر خود نسبت می‌دهید. پس آیا به پرسش‌های من درباره‌ی او را پاسخ می‌دهید»؟ یاران پیامبر (از سخن وی به وحشت افتادند ولی علی (فرمود: «آری، خداوند به هیچ پیامبری درجه و به هیچ فرستاده‌ای فضیلتی نداد مگر آنکه همه‌ی آن‌ها را برای محمّد (گرد آورد و به آن جناب چند برابر افزون‌تر بخشیده است» ... یهودی گفت: «خداوند از دشمنان هود (به‌وسیله‌ی باد انتقام گرفت آیا برای حضرت محمّد (نیز چنین چیزی پیش آمده است»؟. فرمود: «صحیح است خداوند به حضرت محمّد (بالاتر از این را داده، خداوند دمار از روزگار دشمنان او به‌وسیله‌ی باد گرفت در جنگ خندق که بادی فرستاد ریگ‌ها را برافشاند و سپاهی از فرشتگان ارسال داشت که مشرکان آن‌ها را نمی‌دیدند و خداوند محمّد (را با هشت هزار فرشته بر هود (تفضیل داد و فضیلت دیگری به ایشان بخشید که باد زمان هود (باد خشم بود ولی باد زمان پیامبر (باد رحمت، و در قرآن کریم می‌فرماید یا أَیُّهَا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا اذْکُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَیْکُمْ إِذْ جاءَتْکُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنا عَلَیْهِمْ رِیحاً وَ جُنُوداً لَمْ تَرَوْها».
9.en: It is narrated from Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him) that he said: "A Jew from the scholars of al-Sham, who had read the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the scriptures of the prophets and understood their proofs, came to a gathering where the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) were present, including Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), Ibn Abbas, and Abu Ma'bad al-Juhani. The Jew said, 'O nation of Muhammad! You have not left any rank for a prophet nor any virtue for a messenger without attributing it to your prophet. Will you answer me regarding what I ask you?' The people hesitated, but Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said, 'Yes. Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, did not grant any prophet a rank or any messenger a virtue without gathering them all for Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and He granted Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) many times more than the prophets...' The Jew said to him, 'Indeed, Hud (peace be upon him) was helped by Allah against his enemies through the wind. Did Allah do anything like this for Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)?' Ali (peace be upon him) replied, 'It was indeed so, and Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) was granted what is even better than that. Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, helped him against his enemies with the wind on the day of the Trench (Khandaq), when He sent against them a wind that scattered pebbles and soldiers whom they did not see. Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, favored Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) over Hud (peace be upon him) with eight thousand angels, and He favored him over Hud (peace be upon him) in that the wind of 'Ad was a wind of wrath, while the wind of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) was a wind of mercy.' Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, says: 'O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see.'"
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 58

9.ar: علی بن إبراهیم (- فَإِنَّهَا نَزَلَتْ فِی قِصَّةِ الأَحْزَابِ مِنْ قُرَیْشِ وَ الْعَرَبِ الَّذِینَ تَحْزَبُوا عَ-لَی رَسُولِ اللهِ (قالَ وَ ذَلِکَ أَنَ قُرَیْشاً تَجَمَّعَتْ فِی سَنَةِ خَمْسٍ مِنَ الْهِجْرَةِ وَ سَارُوا فِی الْعَرَبِ وَ جَلَبُوا وَ اسْتَفَزُّوهُمْ لِحَرْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَوَافَوْا فِی عَشَرَةِ آلَافٍ وَ مَعَهُمْ کِنَانَةُ وَ سُلَیْمٌ وَ فَزَارَةُ، وَ کَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (حِینَ أَجْلَی بَنِی النَّضِیرِ وَ هُمْ بَطْنٌ مِنَ الْیَهُودِ مِنَ الْمَدِینَةِ وَ کَانَ رَئِیسُهُمْ حُیَیَّ بْنَ أَخْطَبَ وَ هُمْ یَهُودُ مِنْ بَنِی هَارُونَ (فَلَمَّا أَجْلَاهُمْ مِنَ الْمَدِینَةِ صَارُوا إِلَی خَیْبَرَ وَ خَرَجَ حُیَیُّ بْنُ أَخْطَبَ وَ هَمَّ إِلَی قُرَیْشٍ بِمَکَّةَ وَ قَالَ لَهُمْ إِنَّ مُحَمَّداً (قَدْ وَتَرَکُمْ وَ وَتَرَنَا وَ أَجْلَانَا مِنَ الْمَدِینَةِ مِنْ دِیَارِنَا وَ أَمْوَالِنَا وَ أَجْلَی بَنِی عَمِّنَا بَنِی قَیْنُقَاعَ فَسِیرُوا فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ اجْمَعُوا حُلَفَاءَکُمْ وَ غَیْرَهُمْ حَتَّی نَسِیرَ إِلَیْهِمْ - فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ بَقِیَ مِنْ قَوْمِی بِیَثْرِبَ سَبْعُمِائَةِ مُقَاتِلٍ وَ هُمْ بَنُو قُرَیْظَةَ وَ بَیْنَهُمْ وَ بَیْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ (عَهْدٌ وَ مِیثَاقٌ وَ أَنَا أَحْمِلُهُمْ عَلَی نَقْضِ الْعَهْدِ بَیْنَهُمْ وَ بَیْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ (وَ یَکُونُونَ مَعَنَا عَلَیْهِمْ فَتَأْتُونَهُ أَنْتُمْ مِنْ فَوْقُ وَ هُمْ مِنْ أَسْفَلُ. وَ کَانَ مَوْضِعُ بَنِی قُرَیْظَةَ مِنَ الْمَدِینَةِ عَلَی قَدْرِ مِیلَیْنِ - وَ هُوَ الْمَوْضِعُ الَّذِی یُسَمَّی بِئْرَ الْمُطَّلِبِ، فَلَمْ یَزَلْ یَسِیرُ مَعَهُمْ حُیَیُّ بْنُ أَخْطَبَ فِی قَبَائِلِ الْعَرَبِ حَتَّی اجْتَمَعُوا قَدْرَ عَشَرَةِ آلَافٍ مِنْ قُرَیْشٍ وَ کِنَانَةَ وَ الْأَقْرَعِ بْنِ حَابِسٍ فِی قَوْمِهِ وَ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ مِرْدَاسٍ فِی بَنِی سُلَیْمٍ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِکَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (فَاسْتَشَارَ أَصْحَابَهُ وَ کَانُوا سَبْعَمِائَةِ رَجُلٍ، فَقَالَ سَلْمَانُ الْفَارِسِیُّ: یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (إِنَّ الْقَلِیلَ لَا یُقَاوِمُ الْکَثِیرَ فِی الْمُطَاوَلَةِ قَالَ: فَمَا نَصْنَعُ قَالَ: نَحْفِرُ خَنْدَقاً یَکُونُ بَیْنَنَا وَ بَیْنَهُمْ حِجَاباً فَیُمْکِنُکَ مَنْعُهُمْ فِی الْمُطَاوَلَةِ، وَ لَا یُمْکِنُهُمْ أَنْ یَأْتُونَّا مِنْ کُلِّ وَجْهٍ - فَإِنَّا کُنَّا مَعَاشِرَ الْعَجَمِ فِی بِلَادِ فَارِسَ إِذَا دَهَمَنَا دَهْمٌ مِنْ عَدُوِّنَا نَحْفِرُ الْخَنَادِقَ فَیَکُونُ الْحَرْبُ مِنْ مَوَاضِعَ مَعْرُوفَةٍ، فَنَزَلَ جَبْرَئِیلُ عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَقَالَ: أَشَارَ سَلْمَانُ بِصَوَابٍ، فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (بِحَفْرِهِ مِنْ نَاحِیَةِ أُحُدٍ إِلَی رَائِحٍ {رَاتِجٍ} وَ جَعَلَ عَلَی کُلِّ عِشْرِینَ خُطْوَةً وَ ثَلَاثِینَ خُطْوَةً قَوْماً مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِینَ وَ الْأَنْصَارِ یَحْفِرُونَهُ، فَأَمَرَ فَحُمِلَتِ الْمَسَاحِی وَ الْمَعَاوِلُ وَ بَدَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (وَ أَخَذَ مِعْوَلًا فَحَفَرَ فِی مَوْضِعِ الْمُهَاجِرِینَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (یَنْقُلُ التُّرَابَ مِنَ الْحُفْرَةِ حَتَّی عَرَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (وَ عَیِیَ وَ قَالَ لَا عَیْشَ إِلَّا عَیْشُ الْآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْأَنْصَارِ وَ الْمُهَاجِرِینَ فَلَمَّا، نَظَرَ النَّاس إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (یَحْفِرُ اجْتَهَدُوا فِی الْحَفْرِ وَ نَقَلُوا التُّرَابَ فَلَمَّا کَانَ فِی الْیَوْمِ الثَّانِی بَکَّرُوا إِلَی الْحَفْرِ - وَ قَعَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (فِی مَسْجِدِ الْفَتْحِ فَبَیْنَا الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَ الْأَنْصَارُ یَحْفِرُونَ إِذْ عَرَضَ لَهُمْ جَبَلٌ لَمْ تَعْمَلِ الْمَعَاوِلُ فِیهِ، فَبَعَثُوا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِیَّ إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (یُعْلِمُهُ بِذَلِکَ، قَالَ جَابِرٌ: فَجِئْتُ إِلَی الْمَسْجِدِ وَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ مُسْتَلْقٍ عَلَی قَفَاهُ وَ رِدَاؤُهُ تَحْتَ رَأْسِهِ وَ قَدْ شَدَّ عَلَی بَطْنِهِ حَجَراً، فَقُلْتُ: یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ قَدْ عَرَضَ لَنَا جَبَلٌ لَمْ تَعْمَلِ الْمَعَاوِلُ فِیهِ فَقَامَ مُسْرِعاً حَتَّی جَاءَهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ فِی إِنَاء فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَ ذِرَاعَیْهِ وَ مَسَحَ عَلَی رَأْسِهِ وَ رِجْلَیْهِ ثُمَّ شَرِبَ وَ مَجَّ مِنْ ذَلِکَ الْمَاءِ فِی فِیهِ ثُمَّ صَبَّهُ عَلَی الْحَجَرِ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ مِعْوَلًا فَضَرَبَ ضَرْبَةً فَبَرَقَتْ بَرْقَةٌ فَنَظَرْنَا فِیهَا إِلَی قُصُورِ الشَّامِ، ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ أُخْرَی فَبَرَقَتْ بَرْقَةٌ نَظَرْنَا فِیهَا إِلَی قُصُورِ الْمَدَائِنِ، ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ أُخْرَی فَبَرَقَتْ بَرْقَةٌ أُخْرَی نَظَرْنَا فِیهَا إِلَی قُصُورِ الْیَمَنِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (أَمَا إِنَّهُ سَیَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ عَلَیْکُمْ هَذِهِ الْمَوَاطِنَ الَّتِی بَرَقَتْ فِیهَا الْبَرْقُ ثُمَّ انْهَالَ عَلَیْنَا الْجَبَلُ کَمَا یَنْهَالُ الرَّمْلُ، فَقَالَ جَابِرٌ: فَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مقوی {مُقْوٍ} أَیْ جَائِعٌ لَمَّا رَأَیْتُ عَلَی بَطْنِهِ الْحَجَرَ فَقُلْتُ: یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (هَلْ لَکَ فِی الْغِذَاءِ قَالَ: مَا عِنْدَکَ یَا جَابِرُ فَقُلْتُ: عَنَاقٌ وَ صَاعٌ مِنْ شَعِیرٍ- فَقَالَ: تَقَدَّمْ وَ أَصْلِحْ مَا عِنْدَکَ، قَالَ: فَجِئْتُ إِلَی أَهْلِی فَأَمَرْتُهَا فَطَحَنَتِ الشَّعِیرَ وَ ذَبَحْتُ الْعَنْزَ وَ سَلَخْتُهَا وَ أَمَرْتُهَا أَنْ تَخْبِزَ وَ تَطْبُخَ وَ تَشْوِیَ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغْتُ مِنْ ذَلِکَ جِئْتُ إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَقُلْتُ: بِأَبِی أَنْتَ وَ أُمِّی یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (قَدْ فَرَغْنَا فَاحْضُرْ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ، فَقَامَ (إِلَی شَفِیرِ الْخَنْدَقِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: مَعَاشِرَ الْمُهَاجِرِینَ وَ الْأَنْصَارِ أَجِیبُوا جَابِراً قَالَ جَابِرٌ: وَ کَانَ فِی الْخَنْدَقِ سَبْعُمِائَةِ رَجُلٍ- فَخَرَجُوا کُلُّهُمْ ثُمَّ لَمْ یَمُرَّ بِأَحَدٍ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِینَ وَ الْأَنْصَارِ إِلَّا قَالَ أَجِیبُوا جَابِراً، قَالَ جَابِرٌ: فَتَقَدَّمْتُ وَ قُلْتُ لِأَهْلِی: وَ اللَّهِ قَدْ أَتَاکِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (بِمَا لَا قِبَلَ لَکِ بِهِ، فَقَالَتْ: أَعْلَمْتَهُ أَنْتَ بِمَا عِنْدَنَا قَالَ: نَعَمْ - قَالَتْ: هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا أَتَی، قَالَ جَابِرٌ: فَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (فَنَظَرَ فِی الْقِدْرِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: اغْرِفِی وَ أَبْقِی ثُمَّ نَظَرَ فِی التَّنُّورِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَخْرِجِی وَ أَبْقِی - ثُمَّ دَعَا بِصَحْفَةٍ فَثَرَدَ فِیهَا وَ غَرَفَ، فَقَالَ: یَا جَابِرُ أَدْخِلْ عَلَیَّ عَشَرَة ً- فَأَدْخَلْتُ عَشَرَةً فَأَکَلُوا حَتَّی نَهِلُوا وَ مَا یُرَی فِی الْقَصْعَةِ إِلَّا آثَارُ أَصَابِعِهِمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ: یَا جَابِرُ عَلَیَّ بِالذِّرَاعِ فَأَتَیْتُهُ بِالذِّرَاعِ فَأَکَلُوهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَدْخِلْ عَلَیَّ عَشَرَةً- فَدَخَلُوا فَأَکَلُوا حَتَّی نَهِلُوا وَ مَا یُرَی فِی الْقَصْعَةِ إِلَّا آثَارُ أَصَابِعِهِمْ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: عَلَیَّ بِالذِّرَاعِ فَأَکَلُوا وَ خَرَجُوا ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَدْخِلْ عَلَیَّ عَشَرَةً فَأَدْخَلْتُهُمْ فَأَکَلُوا حَتَّی نَهِلُوا- وَ لَمْ یُرَ فِی الْقَصْعَةِ إِلَّا آثَارُ أَصَابِعِهِمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ: یَا جَابِرُ عَلَیَّ بِالذِّرَاعِ فَأَتَیْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ: یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (کَمْ لِلشَّاةِ مِنْ ذِرَاعٍ قَالَ: ذِرَاعَانِ، فَقُلْتُ: وَ الَّذِی بَعَثَکَ بِالْحَقِّ نَبِیّاً لَقَدْ أَتَیْتُکَ بِثَلَاثَةٍ، فَقَالَ: أَمَا لَوْ سَکَتَّ یَا جَابِرُ لَأَکَلُوا النَّاسُ کُلُّهُمْ مِنَ الذِّرَاعِ، قَالَ جَابِرُ: فَأَقْبَلْتُ أُدْخِلُ عَشَرَةً عَشَرَةً- فَدَخَلُوا فَیَأْکُلُونَ حَتَّی أَکَلُوا کُلُّهُمْ - وَ بَقِیَ وَ اللَّهِ لَنَا مِنْ ذَلِکَ الطَّعَامِ مَا عِشْنَا بِهِ أَیَّاماً -. قَالَ: وَ حَفَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (الْخَنْدَقَ وَ جَعَلَ لَهُ ثَمَانِیَةَ أَبْوَابٍ - وَ جَعَلَ عَلَی کُلِّ بَابٍ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِینَ وَ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ مَعَ جَمَاعَةٍ یَحْفَظُونَهُ وَ قَدِمَتْ قُرَیْشٌ وَ کِنَانَةُ وَ سُلَیْمٌ وَ هِلَالٌ فَنَزَلُوا الرَّغَابَةَ فَفَرَغَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (مِنْ حَفْرِ الْخَنْدَقِ - قَبْلَ قُدُومِ قُرَیْشٍ بِثَلَاثَةِ أَیَّامٍ، فَأَقْبَلَتْ قُرَیْشٌ وَ مَعَهُمْ حُیَیُّ بْنُ أَخْطَبَ فَلَمَّا نَزَلُوا الْعَقِیقَ جَاءَ حُیَیُّ بْنُ أَخْطَبَ إِلَی بَنِی قُرَیْظَةَ فِی جَوْفِ اللَّیْلِ وَ کَانُوا فِی حِصْنِهِمْ قَدْ تَمَسَّکُوا بِعَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَدَقَّ بَابَ الْحِصْنِ فَسَمِعَ کَعْبُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ قَرْعَ الْبَابِ فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ: هَذَا أَخُوکِ قَدْ شَأَمَ قَوْمَهُ وَ جَاءَ الْآنَ یَشْأَمُنَا وَ یُهْلِکُنَا - وَ یَأْمُرُنَا بِنَقْضِ الْعَهْدِ بَیْنَنَا وَ بَیْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ (وَ قَدْ وَفَی لَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ (وَ أَحْسَنَ جِوَارَنَا فَنَزَلَ إِلَیْهِ مِنْ غُرْفَتِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ: مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ: حُیَیُّ بْنُ أَخْطَبَ قَدْ جِئْتُکَ بِعِزِّ الدَّهْرِ، فَقَالَ کَعْبٌ: بَلْ جِئْتَنِی بِذُلِّ الدَّهْرِ، فَقَالَ: یَا کَعْبُ هَذِهِ قُرَیْشٌ فِی قَادَتِهَا وَ سَادَتِهَا- قَدْ نَزَلَتْ بِالْعَقِیقِ مَعَ حُلَفَائِهِمْ مِنْ کِنَانَةَ وَ هَذِهِ فَزَارَةُ مَعَ قَادَتِهَا وَ سَادَتِهَا قَدْ نَزَلَتِ الرغابة {الزُّغَابَةَ} وَ هَذِهِ سُلَیْمٌ وَ غَیْرُهُمْ قَدْ نَزَلُوا حِصْنَ بَنِی ذُبْیَانَ وَ لَا یُفْلِتُ مُحَمَّدٌ (وَ أَصْحَابُهُ مِنْ هَذَا الْجَمْعِ أَبَداً فَافْتَحِ الْبَابَ وَ انْقُضِ الْعَهْدَ الَّذِی بَیْنَکَ وَ بَیْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ (فَقَالَ کَعْبٌ: لَسْتُ بِفَاتِحٍ لَکَ الْبَابَ ارْجِعْ مِنْ حَیْثُ جِئْتَ فَقَالَ حُیَیٌّ: مَا یَمْنَعُکَ مِنْ فَتْحِ الْبَابِ - إِلَّا حَشِیشَتُکَ {خَسِیسَتُکَ} الَّتِی فِی التَّنُّورِ تَخَافُ أَنْ أَشْرَکَکَ فِیهَا- فَافْتَحْ فَإِنَّکَ آمِنٌ مِنْ ذَلِکَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ کَعْبٌ: لَعَنَکَ اللَّهُ قَدْ دَخَلْتَ عَلَیَّ مِنْ بَابٍ دَقِیقٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ: افْتَحُوا لَهُ الْبَابَ، فَفَتَحُوا لَهُ الْبَابَ، فَقَالَ: وَیْلَکَ یَا کَعْبُ انْقُضِ الْعَهْدَ الَّذِی بَیْنَکَ وَ بَیْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ (وَ لَا تَرُدَّ رَأْیِی فَإِنَّ مُحَمَّداً (لَا یُفْلِتُ مِنْ هَذَا الْجَمْعِ أَبَداً- فَإِنْ فَاتَکَ هَذَا الْوَقْتُ لَا تُدْرِکُ مِثْلَهُ أَبَداً، قَالَ: وَ اجْتَمَعَ کُلُّ مَنْ کَانَ فِی الْحِصْنِ مِنْ رُؤَسَاءِ الْیَهُودِ مِثْلِ غَزَالِ بْنِ شمول وَ یَاسِرِ بْنِ قَیْسٍ وَ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ زَیْدٍ وَ الزُّبَیْرِ بْنِ یاطا فَقَالَ لَهُمْ کَعْبٌ: مَا تَرَوْنَ قَالُوا: أَنْتَ سَیِّدُنَا وَ الْمُطَاعُ فِینَا وَ أَنْتَ صَاحِبُ عَهْدِنَا فَإِنْ نَقَضْتَ نَقَضْنَا وَ إِنْ أَقَمْتَ أَقَمْنَا مَعَکَ وَ إِنْ خَرَجْتَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَکَ، فَقَالَ الزُّبَیْرُ بْنُ یاطا وَ کَانَ شَیْخاً کَبِیراً مُجَرَّباً قَدْ ذَهَبَ بَصَرُهُ. قَدْ قَرَأْتُ التَّوْرَاةَ الَّتِی أَنْزَلَهَا اللَّهُ فِی سَفَرِنَا بِأَنَّهُ یَبْعَثُ نَبِیّاً فِی آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ یَکُونُ مَخْرَجُهُ بِمَکَّةَ وَ مُهَاجَرَتُهُ بِالْمَدِینَةِ إِلَی الْبَحِیرَةِ یَرْکَبُ الْحِمَارَ الْعَرَبِیَّ وَ یَلْبَسُ الشَّمْلَةَ - وَ یَجْتَزِی بِالْکُسَیْرَاتِ وَ التُّمَیْرَاتِ وَ هُوَ الضَّحُوکُ الْقَتَّالُ - فِی عَیْنَیْهِ حُمْرَةٌ وَ بَیْنَ کَتِفَیْهِ خَاتَمُ النُّبُوَّةِ - یَضَعُ سَیْفَهُ عَلَی عَاتِقِهِ لَا یُبَالِی مَنْ لَاقَاهُ - یَبْلُغُ سُلْطَانَهُ مُنْقَطَعَ الْخُفِّ وَ الْحَافِرِ فَإِنْ کَانَ هَذَا هُوَ فَلَا یَهُولَنَّهُ هَؤُلَاءِ وَ جَمْعُهُمْ - وَ لَوْ نَاوَتْهُ هَذِهِ الْجِبَالُ الرَّوَاسِی لَغَلَبَهَا فَقَالَ حُیَیٌّ: لَیْسَ هَذَا ذَلِکَ وَ ذَلِکَ النَّبِیُّ مِنْ بَنِی إِسْرَائِیلَ وَ هَذَا مِنَ الْعَرَبِ مِنْ وُلْدِ إِسْمَاعِیلَ (وَ لَا یَکُونُ بَنُو إِسْرَائِیلَ أَتْبَاعاً لِوُلْدِ إِسْمَاعِیلَ (أَبَداً لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ فَضَّلَهُم عَلَی النَّاسِ جَمِیعاً وَ جَعَلَ مِنْهُمُ النُّبُوَّةَ وَ الْمُلْکَ وَ قَدْ عَهِدَ إِلَیْنَا مُوسَی (أَلَّا نُؤْمِنَ لِرَسُولٍ حَتَّی یَأْتِیَنا بِقُرْبانٍ تَأْکُلُهُ النَّارُ وَ لَیْسَ مَعَ مُحَمَّدٍ (آیَةٌ وَ إِنَّمَا جَمَعَهُمْ جَمْعاً وَ سَحَرَهُمْ وَ یُرِیدُ أَنْ یَغْلِبَهُمْ بِذَلِکَ، فَلَمْ یَزَلْ یَقْلِبُهُمْ عَنْ رَأْیِهِمْ حَتَّی أَجَابُوهُ - فَقَالَ لَهُمْ أَخْرِجُوا الْکِتَابَ الَّذِی بَیْنَکُمْ وَ بَیْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ فَأَخْرَجُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُ حُیَیُّ بْنُ أَخْطَبَ وَ مَزَّقَهُ وَ قَالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ الْأَمْرُ فَتَجَهَّزُوا فِیمَا بَیْنَنَا، قَالَ حُذَیْفَةُ فَبَادَرْتُ أَنَا فَقُلْتُ لِلَّذِی عَنْ یَمِینِی مَنْ أَنْتَ فَقَالَ: أَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْعَاصِ ثُمَّ قُلْتُ لِلَّذِی عَنْ یَسَارِی مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ: أَنَا مُعَاوِیَةُ وَ إِنَّمَا بَادَرْتُ إِلَی ذَلِکَ لِئَلَّا یَسْأَلَنِی أَحَدٌ مَنْ أَنْتَ، ثُمَّ رَکِبَ أَبُو سُفْیَانَ رَاحِلَتَهُ وَ هِیَ مَعْقُولَةٌ وَ لَوْ لَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (قَالَ لَا تُحْدِثْ حَدَثاً- حَتَّی تَرْجِعَ إِلَیَّ لَقَدَرْتُ أَنْ أَقْتُلَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو سُفْیَانَ لِخَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِیدِ یَا أَبَا سُلَیْمَانَ لَا بُدَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُقِیمَ أَنَا وَ أَنْتَ عَلَی ضُعَفَاءِ النَّاسِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ارْتَحِلُوا إِنَّا مُرْتَحِلُونَ فَفَرُّوا مُنْهَزِمِینَ - فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (قَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ: لَا تَبْرَحُوا- فَلَمَّا طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ دَخَلُوا الْمَدِینَةَ وَ بَقِیَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (فِی نَفَرٍ یَسِیرٍوَ کَانَ ابْنُ فَرْقَدٍ الْکِنَانِیُّ رَمَی سَعْد بْنَ مُعَاذٍ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ بِسَهْمٍ فِی الْخَنْدَقِ فَقَطَعَ أَکْحَلَهُ فَنَزَفَهُ الدَّمُ فَقَبَضَ سَعْدٌ عَلَی أَکْحَلِهِ بِیَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ کُنْتَ أَبْقَیْتَ مِنْ حَرْبِ قُرَیْشٍ شَیْئاً فَأَبْقِنِی لَهَا فَلَا أَحَدَ أَحَبُّ إِلَیَّ مُحَارَبَتُهُمْ مِنْ قَوْمٍ حَادُّوا اللَّهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ وَ إِنْ کَانَتِ الْحَرْبُ قَدْ وَضَعَتْ أَوْزَارَهَا بَیْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ بَیْنَ قُرَیْشٍ فَاجْعَلْهَا لِی شَهَادَةً وَ لَا تُمِتْنِی حَتَّی تُقِرَّ عَیْنِی مِنْ بَنِی قُرَیْظَةَ فَأَمْسَکَ الدَّمُ وَ تَوَرَّمَتْ یَدُهُ. وَ ضَرَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (لَهُ فِی الْمَسْجِدِ خَیْمَةً وَ کَانَ یَتَعَاهَدُهُ بِنَفْسِهِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ یا أَیُّهَا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا اذْکُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَیْکُمْ إِذْ جاءَتْکُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنا عَلَیْهِمْ رِیحاً وَ جُنُوداً لَمْ تَرَوْها وَ کانَ اللهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ إِذْ جاؤُکُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِکُمْ وَ مِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْکُمْ یَعْنِی بَنِی قُرَیْظَة حِینَ غَدَرُوا وَ خَافُوهُم أصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللهِ (وَ إِذْ زاغَتِ الْأَبْصارُ وَ بَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَناجِرَ إلَی قَوْلِهِ إِنْ یُرِیدُونَ إِلَّا فِراراً وَ هُمُ الَّذینَ قَالُوا لِرَسُولِ اللهِ (تَأَذَّنْ لَنَا نَرْجِعْ إلَی مَنَازِلِنَا فَإنَّها فِی أطْرافِ الْمَدینَةِ وَ نَخَافُ الْیَهُودَ عَلَیْهَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللهُ فِیهِم إِنَّ بُیُوتَنا عَوْرَةٌ وَ ما هِیَ بِعَوْرَةٍ - إِنْ یُرِیدُونَ إِلَّا فِرارا.
9.en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim said: This verse was revealed regarding the story of the Confederates (al-Ahzab) from the Quraysh and the Arab tribes who banded together against the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). The matter was that in the fifth year of the Hijrah, the Quraysh gathered together and went among the Arab tribes, inciting them and stirring them up to fight the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). They assembled ten thousand warriors, including the tribes of Kinanah, Sulaym, and Fazarah.

When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had expelled the Banu al-Nadir—a clan of the Jews from the lineage of Aaron—from Medina, they went to Khaybar. Their leader, Huyayy ibn Akhtab, went to the Quraysh in Mecca and said to them: "Muhammad has wronged you and us; he has expelled us from Medina, from our homes and our wealth, and he has expelled our cousins, the Banu Qaynuqa. So, travel through the land and gather your allies and others so that we may march against them. There remain seven hundred fighters of my people in Yathrib, the Banu Qurayzah, and there is a covenant and treaty between them and Muhammad. I will induce them to break the covenant between them and Muhammad, and they will be with us against them. You will come upon him from above, and they will come from below." The location of the Banu Qurayzah was about two miles from Medina, at a place called Bi'r al-Muttalib.

Huyayy ibn Akhtab continued to travel with them among the Arab tribes until they gathered about ten thousand men from the Quraysh, Kinanah, al-Aqra' ibn Habis with his people, and Abbas ibn Mirdas with the Banu Sulaym. This news reached the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), so he consulted his companions, who numbered seven hundred men. Salman al-Farsi said: "O Messenger of Allah, a small force cannot resist a large one in a prolonged engagement." He asked: "What shall we do?" Salman replied: "We should dig a trench to serve as a barrier between us and them. This will allow you to hold them off during a long siege, and they will not be able to come at us from every direction. We, the people of Persia, when we were suddenly overwhelmed by an enemy, would dig trenches so that the fighting would be confined to known positions." Gabriel then descended upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: "Salman has suggested what is correct."

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered the digging of the trench from the side of Uhud to Ratij. He assigned a group of the Muhajirun and Ansar to dig every twenty or thirty paces. He ordered the shovels and pickaxes to be brought, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) began by taking a pickaxe and digging in the section of the Muhajirun himself, while the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) carried the dirt from the trench until the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) perspired and became exhausted, saying: "There is no life but the life of the Hereafter; O Allah, forgive the Ansar and the Muhajirun." When the people saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) digging, they exerted themselves in the work and moved the dirt.

On the second day, they went early to the trench, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sat in the Mosque of al-Fath. While the Muhajirun and Ansar were digging, they encountered a rock that the pickaxes could not break. They sent Jabir ibn Abd Allah al-Ansari to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) to inform him. Jabir said: "I came to the mosque and found the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) lying on his back, his cloak under his head, and he had tied a stone against his stomach. I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, we have encountered a rock that the pickaxes cannot break.' He stood up quickly and came to it. He then called for water in a vessel, washed his face and forearms, wiped his head and feet, drank, spat some of the water into his mouth, and poured it onto the rock. Then he took a pickaxe and struck it. A flash of light appeared, and in it, we saw the palaces of Syria. He struck it again, another flash appeared, and we saw the palaces of al-Mada'in. He struck it a third time, another flash appeared, and we saw the palaces of Yemen." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Indeed, Allah will open these lands for you where the light flashed." Then the rock crumbled like sand.

Jabir said: "When I saw the stone on the stomach of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), I knew he was hungry. I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, would you like some food?' He asked: 'What do you have, Jabir?' I said: 'A young goat and a sa' of barley.' He said: 'Go ahead and prepare what you have.' I went to my family and ordered them to grind the barley, and I slaughtered the goat and skinned it, and told them to bake and cook and roast. When I finished, I came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: 'May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Messenger of Allah, we have finished, so come with whomever you wish.' He stood up at the edge of the trench and said: 'O company of the Muhajirun and Ansar, answer Jabir.'" Jabir said: "There were seven hundred men in the trench, and they all came out. He did not pass by any of the Muhajirun or Ansar without saying: 'Answer Jabir.'"

Jabir said: "I went ahead and said to my family: 'By Allah, Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), has come to you with a number you cannot handle.' She asked: 'Did you tell him what we have?' I said: 'Yes.' She said: 'He knows better what he has brought.' Jabir said: "The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered, looked into the pot, and said: 'Serve, but keep some back.' Then he looked into the oven and said: 'Take out, but keep some back.' Then he called for a platter, crumbled bread into it, and served. He said: 'O Jabir, bring ten men to me.' I brought ten, and they ate until they were full, and nothing was seen in the bowl but the traces of their fingers. Then he said: 'O Jabir, bring me the shoulder.' I brought it, and they ate. Then he said: 'Bring ten men to me.' They entered and ate until they were full, and nothing was seen in the bowl but the traces of their fingers. Then he said: 'Bring me the shoulder.' They ate and left. Then he said: 'Bring ten men to me.' I brought them, and they ate until they were full, and nothing was seen in the bowl but the traces of their fingers. Then he said: 'O Jabir, bring me the shoulder.' I brought it and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, how many shoulders does a goat have?' He said: 'Two.' I said: 'By the One who sent you with the truth as a Prophet, I brought you three.' He said: 'O Jabir, had you remained silent, all the people would have eaten from the shoulder.' Jabir said: "I continued to bring them ten by ten, and they all ate until they were finished, and by Allah, there remained for us from that food enough to live on for days."

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) dug the trench and provided it with eight gates, placing a man from the Muhajirun and a man from the Ansar at each gate with a group to guard it. The Quraysh, Kinanah, Sulaym, and Hilal arrived and camped at al-Raghabah. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had finished digging the trench three days before the arrival of the Quraysh. The Quraysh arrived with Huyayy ibn Akhtab. When they camped at al-Aqiq, Huyayy ibn Akhtab went to the Banu Qurayzah in the middle of the night, while they were in their fortress, holding fast to the covenant of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). He knocked on the door of the fortress. Ka'b ibn Asad heard the knocking and said to his family: "This is your brother who has brought misfortune to his people and has now come to bring misfortune to us and destroy us, ordering us to break the covenant between us and Muhammad, even though Muhammad has been faithful to us and has treated us well as neighbors." He went down to him from his room and said: "Who are you?" He said: "I am Huyayy ibn Akhtab, and I have brought you the glory of the age." Ka'b said: "Rather, you have brought me the disgrace of the age."

Huyayy said: "O Ka'b, here is the Quraysh with their leaders and masters, having camped at al-Aqiq with their allies from Kinanah. Here is Fazarah with their leaders and masters, having camped at al-Zughabah. Here is Sulaym and others, having camped at the fortress of the Banu Dhubyan. Muhammad and his companions will never escape from this gathering. So open the door and break the covenant that is between you and Muhammad." Ka'b said: "I will not open the door for you; return from where you came." Huyayy said: "Nothing prevents you from opening the door except your meager food in the oven, fearing that I might share it with you. Open it, for you are safe from that." Ka'b said: "May Allah curse you, you have entered upon me through a narrow door." Then he said: "Open the door for him." They opened it, and he said: "Woe to you, O Ka'b, break the covenant between you and Muhammad and do not reject my opinion, for Muhammad will never escape from this gathering. If you miss this moment, you will never attain the like of it again."

All the Jewish leaders who were in the fortress gathered, such as Ghazal ibn Shamul, Yasir ibn Qays, Rifa'ah ibn Zayd, and al-Zubayr ibn Bata. Ka'b said to them: "What do you think?" They said: "You are our master and the one obeyed among us, and you are the one who holds our covenant. If you break it, we break it; if you remain, we remain with you; if you go out, we go out with you." Al-Zubayr ibn Bata, who was a very old, experienced man who had lost his sight, said: "I have read the Torah that Allah revealed in our book, that He will send a Prophet in the end of time whose emergence will be in Mecca and his migration to Medina, to the lake. He will ride the Arabian donkey, wear the cloak, and be content with crumbs and dates. He is the smiling, fighting one, with redness in his eyes and the seal of prophethood between his shoulders. He places his sword on his shoulder and does not care who he meets. His authority will reach the ends of the earth. If this is he, then let not these people and their gathering frighten him; even if these towering mountains opposed him, he would overcome them."

Huyayy said: "This is not him; that Prophet is from the Children of Israel, and this one is from the Arabs, from the descendants of Ishmael. The Children of Israel will never be followers of the descendants of Ishmael, because Allah has favored them over all people and placed prophethood and kingship among them. Moses (peace be upon him) has covenanted with us not to believe in a messenger until he brings us an offering that fire consumes, and Muhammad has no sign; he has only gathered them and bewitched them, and he wants to overcome them with that." He continued to turn them from their opinion until they answered him. He said to them: "Bring out the document that is between you and Muhammad." They brought it out, and Huyayy ibn Akhtab took it, tore it up, and said: "The matter has come to pass; prepare yourselves for battle."

This reached the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and it grieved him severely, and his companions were terrified. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Sa'd ibn Mu'adh and Usayd ibn Hudayr—who were from the Aws, and the Banu Qurayzah were allies of the Aws—"Go to the Banu Qurayzah and see what they have done. If they have broken the covenant, do not inform anyone when you return to me, but say: 'Adal and al-Qarah.'" Sa'd ibn Mu'adh and Usayd ibn Hudayr came to the door of the fortress. Ka'b looked down at them from the fortress and insulted Sa'd and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). Sa'd said to him: "You are but a fox in a hole. We will surely hand you over to the Quraysh, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) will besiege you, bring you down to humiliation, and strike your neck." Then they returned to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: "Adal and al-Qarah." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "They are cursed; we ordered them [not to do that]." The reason is that during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), there were spies for the Quraysh, and Adal and al-Qarah were two Arab tribes who entered Islam and then betrayed it. Whenever someone betrayed, this proverb was used: "Adal and al-Qarah."

Huyayy ibn Akhtab returned to Abu Sufyan and the Quraysh and informed them of the Banu Qurayzah's breaking of the covenant between them and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). The Quraysh rejoiced at this. In the middle of the night, Nu'aym ibn Mas'ud al-Ashja'i came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)—he had embraced Islam three days before the arrival of the Quraysh—and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have believed in Allah and affirmed you, and I have hidden my faith from the disbelievers. If you order me to come to you and support you with my person, I will do it, and if you order me to sow discord between the Jews and the Quraysh so that they do not come out of their fortress, I will do it." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Sow discord between the Jews and the Quraysh, for that is more effective to me." He said: "Do you permit me to say about you what I wish?" He said: "Say whatever occurs to you."

He came to Abu Sufyan and said to him: "You know my affection for you and my advice and my love that Allah should grant you victory over your enemy. It has reached me that Muhammad has agreed with the Jews that they should enter your camp and turn against you, and he promised them that if they did so, he would return to them their wings which he cut off for the Banu al-Nadir and Qaynuqa. I do not think you should let them enter your camp until you take hostages from them and send them to Mecca, so you may be safe from their deception and betrayal." Abu Sufyan said: "May Allah grant you success and reward you well; one like you gives the best advice." Abu Sufyan did not know of Nu'aym's Islam, nor did any of the Jews.

Then he went immediately to the Banu Qurayzah and said: "O Ka'b, you know my affection for you. It has reached me that Abu Sufyan said: 'We will bring these Jews out and place them in the face of Muhammad. If they are victorious, the credit is ours, not theirs, and if it goes against us, these will be the vanguard of the war.' I do not think you should let them enter your camp until you take ten of their nobles to be in your fortress. If they are not victorious over Muhammad, they will not leave until they return your covenant and contract between Muhammad and you, because if the Quraysh turn away and are not victorious over Muhammad, Muhammad will attack you and kill you." They said: "You have done well and given excellent advice; we will not come out of our fortress until we take hostages from them to be in our fortress."

The Quraysh came, and when they looked at the trench, they said: "This is a trick the Arabs did not know before." It was said to them: "This is from the planning of the Persian who is with him." Amr ibn Abd Wudd, Hubayrah ibn Wahb, and Dirar ibn al-Khattab arrived at the trench. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had lined up his companions before him. They shouted at their horses until they jumped the trench to the side of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). The companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) all became behind the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and they put the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) in front of them. A man from the Muhajirun said to a man next to him: "Do you not see this devil, Amr? By Allah, no one escapes his hands. Let us hand Muhammad over to him so he may kill him, and we will join our people."

At that time, Allah revealed to His Prophet: "Allah knows those among you who hinder others and those who say to their brothers, 'Come to us,' and they do not come to the battle except a few, being stingy toward you..." (Al-Ahzab/ 18-19).

Amr ibn Abd Wudd planted his spear in the ground and began to circle around it, reciting poetry: "I have become hoarse from calling to your gathering: Is there any challenger? I stood when the brave were cowardly, in the positions of the confronting peer. I am like that, always rushing toward turmoil. Indeed, bravery in a young man and generosity are among the best instincts." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Who will deal with this dog?" No one answered him. The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) stood up and said: "I will, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "O Ali, this is Amr ibn Abd Wudd, the knight of Yalyal." He said: "I am Ali ibn Abi Talib." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Come near me." He came near, and he wrapped the turban on his head with his own hand, gave him his sword, Dhu al-Fiqar, and said: "Go and fight with this." He said: "O Allah, protect him from before him, from behind him, from his right, from his left, from above him, and from below him."

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) walked with a trot, saying: "Do not be hasty, for the one who answers your call has come to you, not incapable, possessing intention and insight, and truthfulness is the savior of every winner. I hope to set up the mourner of funerals over you, with a deep blow whose sound will remain after the turmoil." Amr said to him: "Who are you?" He said: "I am Ali ibn Abi Talib, the cousin of the Messenger of Allah and his son-in-law." He said: "By Allah, your father was an old friend of mine, and I hate to kill you. Your cousin will not be safe when he sent you to me, for I will snatch you with this spear of mine and leave you suspended between heaven and earth, neither alive nor dead." The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said to him: "My cousin knew that if you killed me, I would enter Paradise and you would be in the Fire, and if I killed you, you would be in the Fire and I would be in Paradise." Amr said: "Both are yours, O Ali; that is then an unfair division."

Ali (peace be upon him) said: "Leave this, O Amr. I heard from you while you were clinging to the curtains of the Ka'bah saying: 'No one will offer me three qualities in war but that I will answer one of them.' I offer you three qualities, so answer me one of them." He said: "Bring them, O Ali." He said: "One of them is that you testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." He said: "Remove this from me, so ask the second." He said: "That you return and turn this army away from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family); if he is truthful, you are the most entitled to him, and if he is a liar, the wolves of the Arabs will suffice you against him." He said: "Then the women of the Quraysh will not speak of that, nor will poets sing in their poems that I was cowardly and turned on my heels from the war and betrayed a people who made me their leader." The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: "The third is that you come down to me, for you are riding and I am walking, so that I may confront you." He jumped off his horse, hamstrung it, and said: "This is a quality I did not think any of the Arabs would demand of me."

Then he began and struck the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) with the sword on his head. The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) warded it off with his shield, but it cut through it, and the sword settled on his head. Ali (peace be upon him) said to him: "O Amr, is it not enough for you that I challenged you while you are the knight of the Arabs, that you sought help against me with a supporter?" Amr turned to look behind him, and the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) struck him quickly on his legs, cutting them both off. A cloud of dust rose between them, and the hypocrites said: "Ali ibn Abi Talib has been killed." Then the dust cleared, and they looked, and the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was on his chest, having taken his beard, wanting to slaughter him. He slaughtered him, then took his head and came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), with blood dripping on his head from Amr's blow and his sword dripping with blood, saying while the head was in his hand: "I am Ali and the son of Abd al-Muttalib; death is better for a young man than fleeing." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "O Ali, did you trick him?" He said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah, war is deception."

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent al-Zubayr to Hubayrah ibn Wahb, and he struck him on his head, splitting his skull. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered Umar ibn al-Khattab to challenge Dirar ibn al-Khattab. When Dirar came out to him, Umar pulled out an arrow for him. Dirar said: "Woe to you, O son of Suhak, do you shoot at me in a duel? By Allah, if you shoot at me, I will not leave a single Qurayshi in Mecca without killing him." Umar fled from him, and Dirar passed toward him and struck him on his head with the spear, then said: "Keep it, O Umar, for I have sworn not to kill a Qurayshi as long as I am able." Umar remembered this for him after he became caliph, so he appointed him.

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) remained fighting them in the trench for fifteen days. Abu Sufyan said to Huyayy ibn Akhtab: "Woe to you, O Jew, where are your people?" Huyayy ibn Akhtab went to them and said: "Woe to you, come out, for you have declared war on Muhammad, and you are neither with Muhammad nor with the Quraysh." Ka'b said: "We will not come out until the Quraysh give us ten of their nobles as hostages to be in our fortress, so that if they are not victorious over Muhammad, they will not leave until Muhammad returns our covenant and contract to us. We do not feel safe that the Quraysh will flee and we will remain in our homes, and Muhammad will attack us and kill our men and enslave our women and children. If we do not come out, perhaps he will return our covenant to us." Huyayy ibn Akhtab said to him: "You hope for what is not to be hoped for; the Arabs have declared war on Muhammad, and you are neither with Muhammad nor with the Quraysh." Ka'b said: "This is from your misfortune; you are a bird that will fly with the Quraysh tomorrow and leave us in our homes, and Muhammad will attack us." He said to him: "You have the covenant of Allah upon me and the covenant of Moses (peace be upon him) that if the Quraysh are not victorious over Muhammad, I will return with you to your fortress, and what befalls you will befall me." Ka'b said: "It is as I have said; if the Quraysh give us hostages to be with us, otherwise we will not come out." Huyayy ibn Akhtab returned to the Quraysh and informed them. When he said they were asking for hostages, Abu Sufyan said: "By Allah, this is the first of their betrayals. Nu'aym ibn Mas'ud was truthful; we have no need for the brothers of monkeys and pigs."

When the matter became prolonged for the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and the siege intensified, they were in a time of severe cold, suffered from hunger, and feared the Jews greatly. The hypocrites spoke what Allah related about them. There remained no one among the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) but that he was a hypocrite, except for a few. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had informed his companions that the Arabs would band together and come from above, and the Jews would betray and they would fear them from below, and that they would suffer severe hardship, but the final outcome would be for him against them. When the Quraysh came and the Jews betrayed, the hypocrites said: "Allah and His Messenger did not promise us anything but delusion" (Al-Ahzab/ 12).

A group had houses on the outskirts of Medina, so they said: "O Messenger of Allah, do you permit us to return to our houses, for they are on the outskirts of Medina and are exposed, and we fear the Jews will raid them." Another group said: "Let us flee and go into the desert and seek refuge with the Bedouins, for what Muhammad promised us was all false." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had ordered his companions to guard Medina at night, and the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was in charge of the entire army at night, guarding them. If anyone from the Quraysh moved, he would confront them. The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) would cross the trench and go near the Quraysh where he could see them, and he would remain standing alone all night praying. When morning came, he would return to his post. The mosque of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) is known there, and whoever knows it comes to it and prays in it; it is more than a bowshot from the Mosque of al-Fath to al-Aqiq.

When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) saw the anxiety of his companions due to the length of the siege, he went up to the Mosque of al-Fath—it is the mountain on which the Mosque of al-Fath is today—and prayed to Allah and confided in Him regarding what He had promised him. Among what he prayed was: "O Succor of the distressed, O Answerer of the prayers of the desperate, O Remover of the great affliction, You are my Master and my Protector and the Protector of my ancestors. Remove our grief, our worry, and our affliction, and remove from us the evil of this people by Your power, Your might, and Your ability." Gabriel descended upon him and said: "O Muhammad, Allah has heard your speech and answered your prayer, and has ordered the Dabbur—which is the wind—along with the angels to defeat the Quraysh and the Confederates." Allah sent the Dabbur upon the Quraysh, and they were defeated, and their tents were uprooted. Gabriel descended and informed him of that.

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) called Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman, who was near him, but he did not answer. He called him again, but he did not answer. He called him a third time, and he said: "Labbayk, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "I call you, and you do not answer me!" He said: "O Messenger of Allah, may my father and mother be sacrificed for you, it is from the fear, the cold, and the hunger." He said: "Enter among the people and bring me their news, and do not do anything until you return to me, for Allah has informed me that He has sent the winds upon the Quraysh and defeated them." Hudhayfah said: "I went, and I was shivering from the cold. By Allah, it was only as long as it took me to cross the trench that I felt as if I were in a bath. I headed for a large tent, and there was a fire dying down and being lit, and there was a tent in which Abu Sufyan was, having dangled his testicles over the fire, shivering from the intensity of the cold, saying: 'O company of Quraysh, if we are fighting the people of heaven, as Muhammad claims, we have no power against the people of heaven, and if we are fighting the people of earth, we can overcome them.' Then he said: 'Let every man of you look at his companion, lest there be a spy for Muhammad among us.' Hudhayfah said: "I rushed and said to the one on my right: 'Who are you?' He said: 'I am Amr ibn al-As.' Then I said to the one on my left: 'Who are you?' He said: 'I am Mu'awiyah.' I was the first to ask so that no one would ask me who I was. Then Abu Sufyan mounted his camel, which was hobbled. If the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had not said 'Do not do anything until you return to me,' I could have killed him." Then Abu Sufyan said to Khalid ibn al-Walid: "O Abu Sulayman, I and you must attend to the weak people." Then he said: "Depart, for we are departing." They fled, defeated.

When morning came, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to his companions: "Do not leave." When the sun rose, they entered Medina, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) remained with a few men. Ibn Farqad al-Kinani had shot Sa'd ibn Mu'adh—may Allah have mercy on him—with an arrow in the trench, which cut his artery, and he bled. Sa'd held his artery with his hand and said: "O Allah, if You have left any of the war of the Quraysh, keep me for it, for no one is more beloved to me to fight than a people who opposed Allah and His Messenger. And if the war has laid down its burdens between the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and the Quraysh, then make it a martyrdom for me, and do not let me die until You cool my eyes regarding the Banu Qurayzah." The bleeding stopped, and his hand swelled. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) set up a tent for him in the mosque and would check on him himself.

Allah revealed: "O you who believe, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to you, and We sent upon them a wind and armies you did not see... when they came to you from above you and from below you..." (Al-Ahzab/ 9-10). This means the Banu Qurayzah when they betrayed, and the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) feared them. "...and when eyes shifted and hearts reached the throats..." to His saying: "...they intend nothing but flight." They are the ones who said to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): "Permit us to return to our homes, for they are on the outskirts of Medina and we fear the Jews for them." Allah revealed about them: "Our houses are exposed, while they were not exposed; they intend nothing but flight" (Al-Ahzab/ 13).

9.ar: الرّسول (- عن أبی جعفر الباقر (عن آبائه (قال َ ذَکَرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ النَّبِیُّ (ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ أَیُّکُمْ یَبْرُزُ إِلَی عَمْرٍو وَ أَضْمَنُ لَهُ عَلَی اللَّهِ الْجَنَّةَ وَ فِی کُلِّ مَرَّةٍ کَانَ یَقُومُ عَلِیٌّ (وَ الْقَوْمُ نَاکِسُو رُءُوسِهِمْ فَاسْتَدْنَاهُ وَ عَمَّمَهُ بِیَدِهِ فَلَمَّا بَرَزَ قَالَ (بَرَزَ الْإِیمَانُ کُلُّهُ إِلَی الشِّرْکِ کُلِّهِ وَ کَانَ عَمْرٌو یَقُولُ: وَ لَقَدْ بَحَحْتُ مِنَ النِّدَاءِ بِجَمْعِهِمْ هَلْ مِنْ مُبَارِزٍ الی ان قال إِلَی قَوْلِهِ فَمَا کَانَ أَسْرَعَ أَنْ صَرَعَهُ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (وَ جَلَسَ عَلَی صَدْرِهِ فَلَمَّا هَمَّ أَنْ یَذْبَحَهُ وَ هُوَ یُکَبِّرُ اللَّهَ وَ یُمَجِّدُهُ قَالَ لَهُ عَمْرٌو یَا عَلِیُّ (قَدْ جَلَسْتَ مِنِّی مَجْلِساً عَظِیماً فَإِذَا قَتَلْتَنِی فَلَا تَسْلُبْنِی حُلَّتِی فَقَالَ (هِیَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَیَّ مِنْ ذَلِکَ وَ ذَبَحَهُ وَ أَتَی بِرَأْسِهِ وَ هُوَ یَخْطِرُ فِی مِشْیَتِهِ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَ لَا تَرَی یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (إِلَی عَلِیٍّ (کَیْفَ یَمْشِی فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (إِنَّهَا لَمِشْیَةٌ لَا یَمْقُتُهَا اللَّهُ فِی هَذَا الْمَقَامِ فَتَلَقَّاهُ وَ مَسَحَ الْغُبَارَ عَنْ عَیْنَیْهِ وَ قَالَ لَوْ وُزِنَ الْیَوْمَ عَمَلُکَ بِعَمَلِ جَمِیعِ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ (لَرَجَحَ عَمَلُکَ عَلَی عَمَلِهِمْ وَ ذَاکَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ یَبْقَ بَیْتٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِکِینَ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ دَخَلَهُ ذُلٌّ بِقَتْلِ عَمْرٍو.
9.fa: پیامبر (- امام باقر (از پدرانش (نقل می‌کند که پیامبر (سه بار فرمود: «کدام شما برای مبارزه با عمرو می‌رود و من نزد خدا برایش ضامن بهشت شوم»؟ و هر بار علی (بلند می‌شد و همه سر به زیر می‌انداختند، او را نزد خود خواند و به دست خود عمامه بر سرش بست پس هنگامی‌که به مبارزه برخاست پیامبر (فرمود: «همه‌ی ایمان به مبارزه‌ی همه‌ی شرک برخاست» و در اینجا بود که عمرو رجزخوانی می‌کرد و می‌گفت: «گلویم گرفت از بس که فریاد کردم - به جمع شماها که آیا مبارزی هست»؟ ... و به‌زودی امیرمؤمنان (او را به خاک افکند و بر سینه‌اش نشست و خواست با ذکر تکبیر و تمجید خدا سرش را ببرد. عمرو گفت: «ای علی (بر نشیمنگاه بزرگی نشستی، وقتی مرا کشتی برهنه‌ام نکن». آن حضرت فرمود: «جامه‌ی تو نزد من از این‌ها زبون‌تر است». و سرش را برید و نزد رسول خدا (آورد عمر گفت: «ای رسول خدا (می‌بینی علی (در راه رفتن خود چه بزرگی می‌کند»؟ فرمود: «این‌گونه راه رفتن را خدا دوست ندارد مگر اینکه در چنین مقامی باشد» و آنگاه رسول خدا (برخاست و به پیشواز امیرمؤمنان (آمد و او را در برگرفت و گرد از چشمانش زدود و فرمود: «این کار امروز تو اگر در ترازو با کار همه‌ی امّت محمّد (سنجیده شود از کار همه آنان سنگین‌تر می‌باشد زیرا هیچ خانه‌ای از مشرکان نماند جز که از کشته‌شدن عمرو دچار خواری گردید».
9.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said three times: "Who among you will go out to face 'Amr, and I will guarantee Paradise for him before Allah?" Each time, Ali (peace be upon him) would stand up while the people kept their heads bowed. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) called him close and placed his turban on his head with his own hands. When he went out to fight, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "All of faith has gone out to face all of polytheism." 'Amr used to recite: "My throat has become hoarse from calling out to your gathering: Is there any challenger?" ... It was not long before the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) threw him to the ground and sat upon his chest. As he intended to behead him while glorifying and praising Allah, 'Amr said to him: "O Ali, you have taken a mighty position upon me; when you kill me, do not strip me of my garment." He (peace be upon him) replied: "It is more insignificant to me than that." He then beheaded him and brought his head while walking with a proud gait. Umar said: "O Messenger of Allah, do you not see how Ali is walking?" The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) replied: "It is a gait that Allah does not dislike in this situation." He then met him, wiped the dust from his eyes, and said: "If your deed today were weighed against the deeds of the entire Ummah of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), your deed would outweigh theirs; for there remained no house among the polytheists but that humiliation entered it through the killing of 'Amr."
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 12, p. 82

9.ar: الرّسول (- عَنْ أَبِی الطُّفَیْلِ عَامِرِ بْنِ وَاثِلَةَ، قَالَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (لَعَنَ أَبَا سُفْیَانَ فِی سَبْعَةِ مَوَاطِنَ فِی کُلِّهِنَّ لَا یَسْتَطِیعُ إِلَّا أَنْ یَلْعَنَهُ: ... وَ الرَّابِعَةُ: یَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ، یَوْمَ جَاءَ أَبُو سُفْیَانَ فِی جَمْعِ قُرَیْشٍ فَرَدَّهُمُ اللَّهُ بِغَیْظِهِمْ لَمْ یَنالُوا خَیْراً، وَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فِی الْقُرْآنِ آیَتَیْنِ فِی سُورَةِ الْأَحْزَابِ، فَسَمَّی أبو {أَبَا} سُفْیَانَ وَ أَصْحَابَهُ کُفَّاراً، وَ مُعَاوِیَةُ یَوْمَئِذٍ مُشْرِکٌ عَدُوٌّ لِلَّهِ وَ لِرَسُولِهِ ... وَ السَّادِسَةُ: یَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ، یَوْمَ جَاءَ أَبُو سُفْیَانَ بِجَمْعِ قُرَیْشٍ وَ عَامِرُ بْنُ الطُّفَیْلِ بِجَمْعِ هَوَازِنَ، وَ عُیَیْنَةُ بْنُ حُصَیْنٍ بِغَطْفَانَ، وَ وَاعَدَهُمْ قُرَیْظَةُ وَ النَّضِیرُ أَنْ یَأْتُوهُمْ فَلَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (الْقَادَةَ وَ الْأَتْبَاعَ، وَ قَالَ: أَمَّا الْأَتْبَاعُ فَلَا تُصِیبُ اللَّعْنَةُ مُؤْمِناً، وَ أَمَّا الْقَادَةُ فَلَیْسَ فِیهِمْ مُؤْمِنٌ وَ لَا نَجِیبٌ وَ لَا نَاجٍ.
9.fa: پیامبر (- ابوطفیل گوید: همانا رسول خدا (در هفت مورد اباسفیان را لعن کرد که در همه‌ی آن‌ها چاره‌ای جز لعن او نداشت. ... چهارمین‌بار، روز خندق بود روزی که ابوسفیان با انبوهی از قریش آمد و خداوند آنان را خشمناک باز گردانید و به چیزی نایل نشدند و خداوند عزّوجلّ دو آیه در سوره‌ی احزاب فرو فرستاد که اباسفیان و یارانش را کفّار نامید و معاویه مشرکی بود دشمن خدا و رسول ... ششمین‌بار روز احزاب بود روزی که ابوسفیان قریش را جمع می‌کرد و عامربن‌طفیل قبیله‌ی هوازن را و عیینهًْ‌بن‌حفص طایفه‌ی غطفان را و قبیله‌های قریظه و نضیر هم وعده‌ی یاریشان داده بودند آن روز رسول خدا (امراء لشکر و نظامیان را لعن کرد. و فرمود: «امّا از نظامیان هرکه ایمان بیاورد لعنت من او را فرا نخواهد گرفت و امّا فرماندهان نه مؤمنی در میانشان هست و نه فرد نجیب و نه رستگار».
9.en: The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) cursed Abu Sufyan on seven occasions, in each of which he could not help but curse him: ... The fourth was the Day of the Trench (al-Khandaq), the day Abu Sufyan came with the gathering of Quraysh, and Allah turned them back in their rage, having attained no good. Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed two verses in the Quran in Surah al-Ahzab, naming Abu Sufyan and his companions as disbelievers (kuffar), and Mu’awiyah was on that day a polytheist, an enemy to Allah and His Messenger... The sixth was the Day of the Confederates (al-Ahzab), the day Abu Sufyan brought the gathering of Quraysh, ‘Amir ibn al-Tufayl brought the gathering of Hawazin, and ‘Uyaynah ibn Hisn brought Ghatafan, and the tribes of Qurayzah and al-Nadir had promised to come to them. The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) cursed the leaders and the followers, and said: "As for the followers, the curse does not strike a believer; but as for the leaders, there is no believer among them, nor any noble person, nor any who shall be saved."

9.ar: الرّسول (- عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (قَالَ: قال رسول الله (عَلَی التَّلِ الَّذِی عَلَیْهِ مَسْجِدُ الْفَتْحِ فِی غَزْوَةِ الْأَحْزَابِ فِی لَیْلَةٍ ظَلْمَاءَ قَرَّةٍ فَقَالَ مَنْ یَذْهَبُ فَیَأْتِیَنَا بِخَ-بَرِهِمْ وَ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ فَلَمْ یَقُمْ أَحَ-دٌ ثُمَّ أَعَادَهَا فَلَمْ یَقُمْ أَحَ-دٌ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (بِیَدِهِ وَ مَا أَرَادَ الْقَوْمُ أَرَادُوا أَفْضَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ قَالَ مَنْ هَذَا فَقَالَ حُذَیْفَةُ فَقَالَ أَ مَا تَسْمَعُ کَلَامِی مُنْذُ اللَّیْلَةِ وَ لَا تَکَلَّمُ أَ قُبِرْتَ فَقَامَ حُذَیْفَةُ وَ هُوَ یَقُولُ الْقُرُّ وَ الضُّرُّ جَعَلَنِیَ اللَّهُ فِدَاکَ مَنَعَنِی أَنْ أُجِیبَکَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (انْطَلِقْ حَتَّی تَسْمَعَ کَلَامَهُمْ وَ تَأْتِیَنِی بِخَبَرِهِمْ فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ قَالَ 9.fa: پیامبر (- ابان از کسی که برایش حدیث کرده نقل می‌کند، امام صادق (می‌فرماید: رسول خدا (در شبی تاریک و سرد در غزوه‌ی احزاب بر روی تپه‌ای که الان مسجد فتح بر روی آن واقع است، ایستاده و فرمود: «چه کسی می‌رود و از آنان برایمان خبر می‌آورد تا بهشت [پاداش] او باشد»؟ هیچ‌کس برنخاست. سپس پیامبر (دوباره آن سؤال را پرسید و [باز] هیچ‌کس برنخاست. امام صادق (با اشاره‌ی دست خود چنین فرمود: «آن قوم، خواهان بهشت نبودند. آیا چیزی برتر از بهشت را می‌خواستند»؟ امام (در ادامه فرمود: «سپس پیامبر (فرمود: «این [مرد] کیست»؟ آن مرد پاسخ داد: «حُذَیفه». پی-امبر (فرمود: «آی-ا از سر شب، سخنم را نمی‌شنیدی که هیچ دم برنیاوردی؟ نزدیک آی». حذیفه درحالی‌که می‌گفت: «سرما و بی‌حالی مرا از پاسخ‌دادن به شما بازداشته بود خداوند مرا فدایتان گرداند»، برخاست. رسول خدا (فرمود: «خدایا! او را از مقابل، پشت، راست و چپ محافظت کن تا او را به‌سوی من بازگردانی». رسول خدا (به حذیفه فرموده بود: «ای حذیفه! هیچ عملی از تو سر نزند، تا آنکه به‌سوی من باز گردی». حذیفه، سلاح، کمان و سپر خود را برداشت. حذیفه گفت: «از آنجا خارج شدم، درحالی‌که هیچ‌گونه بی‌حالی را احساس نکردم. از مقابل دروازه خندق عبور کردم و دیدم که همه‌ی مؤمنان و کفّار به این سرماخوردگی و بی‌حالی دچار شده‌اند». هنگامی‌که حذیفه، به راه افتاد، رسول خدا (برجست و ندا داد: «ای فریادرس دردمندان و ای اجابت‌کننده‌ی دعای درماندگان! اندوه، غم و غصه‌ی من را بزدای؛ چراکه تو چگونگی حال من و اصحابم را مشاهده می‌کنی». دراین‌هنگام جبرئیل بر پیامبر (نازل شد و گفت: «ای رسول خدا (! خداوند عزّوجلّ سخن و دعای تو را شنیده و تو را مورد اجابت قرار داده است و دیگر از دشمنت بیم و هراس نداشته باش. [و هراس دشمنت را از تو دور کرد] پس رسول خدا (دو زانو نشست و دستان خود را گشود و اشک از دیدگان ایشان روان شد. سپس عرض کرد: «سپاسگزارم، سپاسگزارم چنان‌که به من و به اصحابم رحم نمودی». سپس جبرئیل فرمود: «ای رسول خدا (! خداوند عزّوجلّ بادی از آسمان دنیا که حامل سنگریزه است و بادی از آسمان چهارم که حامل سنگ است به‌سوی آنان فرستاد». حذیفه گفت: «پس بیرون رفتم و ناگهان خود را در میان آتش آن قوم یافتم و لشکر اوّل خداوند که بادی حامل سنگریزه بود، روی آورد و آتش آنان را به کلّی پراکنده و خاموش ساخت و تمام خیمه‌های آنان را بر زمین افکند و تمامی نیزه‌های آنان را بر زمین انداخت تا اینکه سپرهای خود را در برابر سنگریزه‌ها قرار دادند و ما صدای برخورد سنگریزه‌ها با سپرها را می‌شنیدیم. دراین‌هنگام حذیفه میان دو مرد از مشرکان نشست. ابلیس در هیئت یک مرد فرمانده که رأی او مطاع است، در میان مشرکان برخاست و گفت: «ای مردم! شما در میدان این جادوگر دروغگو قرار گرفتهاید. اگر الان عقب‌نشینی کنید چیزی از دست نمی‌دهید؛ چراکه این عذاب، یک قحطی دائمی نیست و شتران و اسبان شما هلاک گشته‌اند. پس بازگردید و هرکدام از شما به هم‌نشین خود بنگرد». حذیفه گفت: «به‌سمت راست خود نگریستم و بر دستان خود کوفته و گفتم: «تو کیستی»؟ او پاسخ داد: «من معاویه هستم». حذیفه می‌گوید: «به کسی که در سمت چپ من بود گفتم: تو کیستی»؟ او پاسخ داد: «من، سهیل‌بن‌عمرو هستم». حذیفه گفت: «و لشکر عظیم خداوند روی آورد. دراین‌هنگام ابوسفیان برخاست و به‌سوی شترش رفت و در میان قبیله‌ی قریش فریاد برآورد: «النجاهًْ النجاهًْ (فرار، فرار)». و طلحه ازدی گفت: «محمّد (به شما شرّ و بدی رسانده است». و سپس برخاست و به‌سوی شتر رفت و در میان قبیله‌ی بنی‌اشجع فریاد زد: «النجاهًْ النجاهًْ (فرار، فرار) عُییَنَهًْ‌بن‌حِصن نیز همین کار را کرد. سپس حارث‌بن‌عَوف مُرّی نیز مانند آن را انجام داد سپس اقرع‌بن‌حابس نیز چنین کرد و تمامی آن حزب‌ها رفتند و حذیفه به‌سوی رسول خدا (بازگشته و ایشان را از آن خبر، آگاه ساخت. امام صادق (فرمود: «آن واقعه شبیه به روز قیامت بود».
9.en:
Aban ibn Uthman narrates from someone who reported it from Abu Abd Allah (Imam al-Sadiq), who said: On a dark, cold night during the Battle of the Confederates (al-Ahzab), the Messenger of Allah (s) stood upon the hill where the Mosque of Fath is now located and said, "Who will go and bring us news of them, and for him shall be Paradise?" No one stood up. The Prophet (s) repeated the request, and again no one stood up. Abu Abd Allah (as) gestured with his hand and said, "The people did not desire Paradise; they desired something even better than Paradise." Then the Prophet (s) asked, "Who is this?" He replied, "Hudhayfah." The Prophet (s) said, "Have you not been hearing my words since the beginning of the night? Why do you not speak? Come closer." Hudhayfah stood up, saying, "May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, the cold and the exhaustion prevented me from answering you." The Messenger of Allah (s) said, "O Allah, protect him from before him, from behind him, from his right, and from his left, until You return him to me." The Prophet (s) then said to him, "O Hudhayfah, do not do anything until you return to me." He took his sword, his bow, and his shield. Hudhayfah said, "I went out, and I felt neither exhaustion nor cold. I passed by the gate of the trench, and I saw that the believers and the disbelievers were all afflicted by the cold and exhaustion."

When Hudhayfah departed, the Messenger of Allah (s) stood and called out, "O Succorer of the distressed, O Responder to the call of the desperate, remove my anxiety, my grief, and my distress, for You see my state and the state of my companions." Then Gabriel descended upon him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, Allah, whose mention is mighty, has heard your words and your prayer, and He has answered you and spared you the terror of your enemy." The Messenger of Allah (s) knelt on his knees, spread his hands, and shed tears, then said, "Gratitude, gratitude, for You have had mercy on me and on my companions." Then the Prophet (s) said, "Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has sent upon them a wind from the lowest heaven containing pebbles, and a wind from the fourth heaven containing stones."

Hudhayfah said, "I went out and found myself amidst the fires of the people. Then the first of Allah’s armies arrived—a wind containing pebbles—which left no fire unextinguished, no tent standing, and no spear upright. They began to use their shields to protect themselves from the pebbles, and we could hear the sound of the pebbles striking the shields." Hudhayfah sat between two of the polytheists. Then Iblis stood up in the form of a man whose authority was obeyed among the polytheists and said, "O people, you have descended upon the courtyard of this lying sorcerer. If you retreat now, you will lose nothing, for this is not a place of permanent stay; your camels and horses have perished. So return, and let every man look at who his companion is." Hudhayfah said, "I looked to my right and struck with my hand, saying, 'Who are you?' He replied, 'Mu'awiyah.' I said to the one on my left, 'Who are you?' He replied, 'Suhayl ibn Amr.'"

Hudhayfah said, "Then the greater army of Allah arrived. Abu Sufyan stood up, went to his mount, and shouted to the Quraysh, 'Escape! Escape!' Talhah al-Azdi said, 'Muhammad has brought you evil,' then he stood up, went to his mount, and shouted to the Banu Ashja, 'Escape! Escape!' Uyaynah ibn Hisn did the same, then al-Harith ibn Awf al-Murri did the same, then al-Aqra ibn Habis did the same. The Confederates departed, and Hudhayfah returned to the Messenger of Allah (s) and informed him of the news." Abu Abd Allah (as) said, "It was as if it were the Day of Resurrection."

9.via: Uqbah ibn Khalid from Abu Abd Allah (Imam al-Sadiq)
9.ar: الرّسول (- عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (قَالَ: تَأْتِی مَسْجِدَ الْأَحْزَابِ فَتُصَلِّی فِیهِ وَ تَدْعُو اللَّهَ فِیهِ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (دَعَا فِیهِ یَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ وَ قَالَ یَا صَرِیخَ الْمَکْرُوبِینَ وَ یَا مُجِیبَ الْمُضْطَرِّینَ وَ یَا مُغِیثَ الْمَهْمُومِینَ اکْشِفْ هَمِّی وَ کَرْبِی فَقَدْ تَرَی حَالِی وَ حَالَ أَصْحَابِی.
9.fa: پیامبر (- عقبهًْ‌بن‌خالد از امام صادق (روایت می‌کند که فرمود: رسول خدا (به مسجد احزاب آمد و در آنجا نماز خواند در روز احزاب در این مسجد دعا خوانده و فرمود: «ای فریادرس اندوهگینان و ای اجابت‌کننده‌ی دعای بیچارگان و ای پناه‌گاه غمگینان و ای فریادرس یاری خواهندگان غصّه و اندوه من را برطرف کن زیرا حال من و حال یارانم را دیده و از آن مطّلع می‌باشی».
9.en: You shall come to the Mosque of the Confederates (Masjid al-Ahzab) and pray in it and call upon Allah in it, for the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) prayed in it on the day of the Confederates and said: "O Succorer of the distressed, O Responder to the desperate, O Reliever of the sorrowful, remove my sorrow and my distress, for You see my state and the state of my companions."

الْفَتْحِ فَصَلَّی رَکْعَتَیْنِ ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تُهْلِکْ هَذِهِ الْعِصَابَةَ لَمْ تُعْبَدْ بَعْدَهَا فِی الْأَرْضِ فَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ رِیحاً قَلَعَتْ خِیَمَ الْمُشْرِکِینَ وَ بَدَّدَتْ رَوَاحِلَهُمْ وَ أَجْهَدَتْهُمْ بِالْبَرْدِ وَ سَفَتِ الرِّمَالَ وَ التُّرَابَ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ جَاءَتْهُ الْمَلَائِکَةُ فَقَالَتْ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَمَرَنَا بِالطَّاعَةِ لَکَ فَمُرْنَا بِمَا شِئْتَ قَالَ زَعْزِعِی الْمُشْرِکِینَ وَ أَرْعِبِیهِمْ وَ کُونُوا مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ فَفَعَلَتْ بِهِمْ ذَلِکَ وَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی یا أَیُّهَا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا اذْکُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَیْکُمْ إِذْ جاءَتْکُمْ جُنُودٌ یَعْنِی أَحْزَابَ الْمُشْرِکِینَ فَأَرْسَلْنا عَلَیْهِمْ رِیحاً وَ جُنُوداً لَمْ تَرَوْها وَ کانَ اللهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِیراً إِذْ جاؤُکُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِکُمْ أَیْ أَحْزَابُ الْعَرَبِ وَ مِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْکُمْ یَعْنِی بَنِی قُرَیْظَةَ حِینَ نَقَضُوا عَهْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ صَارُوا مَعَ الْأَحْزَابِ عَلَی الْمُسْلِمِینَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ مِنْ مَسْجِدِ الْفَتْحِ إِلَی مُعَسْکَرِهِ فَصَاحَ بِحُذَیْفَةَ بْنِ الْیَمَانِ وَ کَانَ قَدْ نَادَاهُ ثَلَاثاً فَقَالَ فِی الثَّالِثَةِ لَبَّیْکَ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (قَالَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتِی وَ لَا تُجِیبُنِی فَقَالَ مَنَعَنِی شِدَّةُ الْبَرْدِ فَقَالَ اعْبُرِ الْخَنْدَقَ فَاعْرِفْ خَبَرَ قُرَیْشٍ وَ الْأَحْزَابِ وَ ارْجِعْ وَ لَا تُحْدِثْ حَدَثاً حَتَّی تَرْجِعَ إِلَیَّ قَالَ فَقُمْتُ وَ أَنَا أَنْتَفِضُ مِنَ الْبَرْدِ فَعَبَرْتُ الْخَنْدَقَ وَ کَأَنِّی فِی الْحَمَّامِ فَصِرْتُ إِلَی مُعَسْکَرِهِمْ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ هُنَاکَ إِلَّا خَیْمَةَ أَبِی سُفْیَانَ وَ عِنْدَهُ جَمَاعَةٌ مِنْ وُجُوهِ قُرَیْشٍ وَ بَیْنَ أَیْدِیهِمْ نَارٌ تَشْتَعِلُ مَرَّةً وَ تَخْبُو أُخْرَی فَانْسَلَلْتُ فَجَلَسْتُ بَیْنَهُمْ فَقَالَ أَبُوسُفْیَانَ إِنْ کُنَّا نُقَاتِلُ أَهْلَ الْأَرْضِ فَنَحْنُ بِالْقُدْرَةِ عَلَیْهِ وَ إِنْ کُنَّا نُقَاتِلُ أَهْلَ السَّمَاءِ کَمَا یَقُولُ مُحَمَّدٌ (فَلَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِأَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ انْظُرُوا بَیْنَکُمْ لَا یَکُونُ لِمُحَمَّدٍ (عَیْنٌ بَیْنَنَا فَلْیَسْأَلْ بَعْضُکُمْ بَعْضاً قَالَ حُذَیْفَةُ فَبَادَرْتُ إِلَی الَّذِی عَنْ یَمِینِی فَقُلْتُ مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِیدِ وَ قُلْتُ لِلَّذِی عَنْ یَسَارِی مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ فُلَانٌ فَلَمْ یَسْأَلْنِی أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُوسُفْیَانَ لِخَالِدٍ إِمَّا أَنْ تَتَقَدَّمَ أَنْتَ فَتَجْمَعَ النَّاسَ لِیَلْحَقَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضاً فَأَکُونَ عَلَی السَّاقَةِ وَ إِمَّا أَنْ أَتَقَدَّمَ أَنَا وَ تَکُونَ عَلَی السَّاقَةِ قَالَ بَلْ أَتَقَدَّمُ أَنَا وَ تَتَأَخَّرُ أَنْتَ فَقَامُوا جَمِیعاً فَتَقَدَّمُوا وَ تَأَخَّرَ أَبُوسُفْیَانَ فَخَرَجَ مِنَ الْخَیْمَةِ وَ اخْتَفَیْتُ فِی ظِلِّهَا فَرَکِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ وَ هِیَ مَعْقُولَةٌ مِنَ الدَّهَشِ الَّذِی کَانَ بِهِ فَنَزَلَ یَحِلُّ الْعِقَالَ فَأَمْکَنَنِی قَتْلَهُ فَلَمَّا هَمَمْتُ بِذَلِکَ تَذَکَّرْتُ قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (لَا تُحْدِثَنَّ حَدَثاً حَتَّی تَرْجِعَ إِلَیَّ فَکَفَفْتُ وَ رَجَعْتُ إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ قَدْ طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ ثُمَّ صَلَّی بِالنَّاسِ الْفَجْرَ وَ نَادَی مُنَادِیهِ لَا یَبْرَحَنَّ أَحَدٌ مَکَانَهُ إِلَی أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فَمَا أَصْبَحَ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ تَفَرَّقَ عَنْهُ الْجَمَاعَةُ إِلَّا نَفَراً یَسِیراً فَلَمَّا طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (وَ مَنْ کَانَ مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ مَنْزِلَهُ أَمَرَ فَنُودِیَ أَلَا لَا یُصَلِّی أَحَدٌ إِلَّا فِی بَنِی قُرَیْظَةَ فَسَارَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ إِلَیْهِمْ فَوَجَدُوا النَّخْلَ مُحْدِقاً بِقَصْرِهِمْ وَ لَمْ یَکُنْ لِلْمُسْلِمِینَ مُعَسْکَرٌ یَنْزِلُونَ فِیهِ وَ وَافَی رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (فَقَالَ مَا لَکُمْ لَا تَنْزِلُونَ فَقَالُوا مَا لَنَا مَکَانٌ فَنَزَلَ مِنِ اشْتِبَاکِ النَّخْلِ فَدَخَلَ فِی طَرِیقٍ بَیْنَ النَّخْلِ فَأَشَارَ بِیَدِهِ یَمْنَةً فَانْضَمَّ النَّخْلُ بَعْضُهُ إِلَی بَعْضٍ وَ أَشَارَ بِیَدِهِ یَسْرَةً فَانْضَمَّ النَّخْلُ کَذَلِکَ وَ اتَّسَعَ لَهُمُ الْمَوْضِعُ فَنَزَلُوا.
9.en:
When the siege intensified against the Muslims during the Battle of the Trench and the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) saw the distress of the people due to the hardships they were enduring, he ascended to the Mosque of Fath and prayed two rak'ahs. Then he said, "O Allah, if this group is destroyed, You will not be worshipped on earth after them." Allah then sent a wind that uprooted the tents of the polytheists, scattered their baggage, afflicted them with cold, and cast sand and dust upon them. The angels came to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, Allah has commanded us to obey you, so command us as you wish." He said, "Shake the polytheists, strike terror into them, and be behind them." They did so to them, and Allah the Exalted revealed: "O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to you" (meaning the confederates of the polytheists), "so We sent upon them a wind and armies you did not see. And ever is Allah, of what you do, Seeing. When they came at you from above you" (meaning the Arab confederates), "and from below you" (meaning the Banu Qurayza, when they broke their covenant with the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) and joined the confederates against the Muslims).

Afterward, the Prophet (PBUH) returned from the Mosque of Fath to his camp and called out for Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman. He called him three times, and on the third time, he replied, "Labbayk, O Messenger of Allah." The Prophet (PBUH) said, "You hear my voice but do not answer me?" He replied, "The intensity of the cold prevented me." The Prophet (PBUH) said, "Cross the trench, find out the news of the Quraysh and the confederates, and return. Do not initiate any action until you return to me." Hudhayfah said, "I stood up, shivering from the cold, and crossed the trench, and it was as if I were in a bathhouse. I reached their camp and found nothing there except the tent of Abu Sufyan, with a group of the notables of Quraysh around him. Before them was a fire that would flare up and then die down. I slipped in and sat among them." Abu Sufyan said, "If we were fighting the people of the earth, we would have the power to do so, but if we are fighting the people of the heaven, as Muhammad (PBUH) claims, then we have no power against the people of the heaven. Look among yourselves; let no one have a spy from Muhammad (PBUH) among us, so let each of you ask the other." Hudhayfah said, "I immediately turned to the one on my right and said, 'Who are you?' He said, 'Khalid ibn al-Walid.' I said to the one on my left, 'Who are you?' He said, 'So-and-so.' None of them asked me who I was."

Then Abu Sufyan said to Khalid, "Either you go ahead and gather the people so they may join one another, and I will be in the rearguard, or I will go ahead and you be in the rearguard." Khalid said, "Rather, I will go ahead and you stay behind." They all stood up and moved forward, and Abu Sufyan stayed behind. He left the tent, and I hid in its shadow. He mounted his camel, which was hobbled due to the panic he was in. He dismounted to untie the hobble, and I had the opportunity to kill him. When I intended to do so, I remembered the words of the Messenger of Allah (PBUH), "Do not initiate any action until you return to me," so I refrained and returned to the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) just as dawn was breaking. He praised Allah, then led the people in the dawn prayer, and his announcer called out, "Let no one leave their place until the sun rises." By morning, the group had dispersed except for a few. When the sun rose, the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) and those with him departed. When he entered his house, he ordered it to be announced that no one should pray except at Banu Qurayza. The Muslims marched toward them and found the palm trees surrounding their fortress, and the Muslims had no camp to settle in. When the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) arrived, he said, "Why do you not dismount?" They said, "We have no place." He stood in a path between the palm trees and gestured with his hand to the right, and the palm trees drew together, and he gestured with his hand to the left, and the palm trees drew together likewise, clearing a space for them, and they dismounted.

9.ar: الرّسول (- فَنَزَلَ جَبْرَئِیلُ (وَ قَالَ یَا مُحَمَّدُ (إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ اسْتَجَابَ دَعْوَتَکَ. فَجَثَا رَسُولُ اللهِ (عَلَی رُکْبَتَیْهِ وَ بَسَطَ یَدَیْهِ وَ أَرْسَلَ بِالدُّمُوعِ عَیْنَیْهِ ثُمَّ نَادَی: شُکْراً شُکْراً کَمَا آوَیْتَنِی وَ آوَیْتَ مَنْ مَعِی. ثُمَّ قَالَ جَبْرَئِیلُ (یَا رَسُولَ اللهِ (إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ نَصَرَکَ وَ بَعَثَ عَلَیْهِمْ رِیحاً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فِیهَا الْحَصَی وَ رِیحاً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ الرَّابِعَةِ فِیهَا الْجَنَادِلُ. قَالَ حُذَیْفَةُ: فَبَعَثَنِی رَسُولُ اللهِ (حَتَّی آتِیَهُ بِخَبَرِهِمْ، فَخَرَجْتُ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِنِیرَانِ الْقَوْمِ قَدْ طَفِئَتْ وَ خَمَدَتْ وَ أَقْبَلَ جُنْدُ اللَّهِ الْأَوَّلُ رِیحٌ شَدِیدٌ فِیهَا الْحَصَی فَمَا تَرَکَتْ نَاراً لَهُمْ إِلَّا أَخْمَدَتْهَا وَ لَا خِبَاءً إِلَّا طَرَحَتْهَا {وَ لَا رُمْحاً إِلَّا أَلْقَاهَا} حَتَّی جَعَلُوا یَتَتَرَّسُونَ مِنَ الْحَصَی وَ کُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ وَقْعَ الْحَصَی فِی التِّرَسَةِ وَ أَقْبَلَ جُنْدُ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمُ. فَقَامَ أَبُو سُفْیَانَ إِلَی رَاحِلَتِهِ ثُمَّ صَاحَ فِی قُرَیْشٍ النَّجَاءَ النَّجَاءَ ثُمَّ فَعَلَ عُیَیْنَةُ بْنُ حِصْنٍ مِثْلَهَا وَ فَعَلَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ مِثْلَهَا وَ ذَهَبَ الْأَحْزَابُ وَ رَجَعَ حُذَیْفَةُ إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ أَخْبَرَهُ الْخَبَرَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ -تَعَالَی جَلَّتْ عَظَمَتُهُ- عَلَی رَسُولِهِ (اذْکُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَیْکُمْ إِذْ جاءَتْکُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنا عَلَیْهِمْ رِیحاً وَ جُنُوداً لَمْ تَرَوْها.
9.fa: پیامبر (- جبرئیل بر پیامبر (نازل شد و گفت: «ای محمّد (! خداوند عزّوجلّ دعای تو را مورد اجابت قرار داده است». پس رسول خدا (دو زانو نشست و دستان خود را گشود و اشک از دیدگانش جاری شد. سپس عرض کرد: «سپاسگزارم، سپاسگزارم، چنان‌که به من و اصحابم پناه دادی». جبرئیل گفت: «ای رسول خدا (! خداوند، تو را یاری کرده و بادی را از آسمان دنیا که حامل سنگریزه است و نیز بادی را از آسمان چهارم که حامل سنگ است، به‌سوی آنان فرستاد». حذیفه می‌گوید: «رسول خدا (مرا فرستاد تا از آن‌ها برای ایشان خبر بیاورم. بیرون رفتم و مشاهده کردم که آتش آن قوم (قریش و احزاب) خاموش شده است و لشکر اوّل خداوند، روی آورد که همان باد شدید حامل سنگریزه بود و تمام آتش‌ها را خاموش ساخت و تمام خیمه‌ها را بر زمین افکند تا اینکه سپرهای خود را در برابر سنگریزه‌ها قرار می‌دادند و من، صدای برخورد سنگریزه‌ها با سپرها را می‌شنیدم». در این هنگام لشکر عظیم خداوند، روی آورد و ابوسفیان به‌سوی شتر خود رفت. سپس در میان قریش، فریاد برآورد: «النَّجاهًْ النَّجاهًْ (فرار، فرار)». سپس عُیَیَنهًْ‌بن‌حِصین (رئیس بنی‌فزاره) همین کار را کرد و حارث‌بن‌عَوف (بزرگ بنی‌مره) نیز مانند آن را انجام داد و تمام احزاب رفتند. حذیفه به نزد رسول خدا (بازگشت و او را از آن خبر آگاه ساخت، و خداوند عزّوجلّ این آیه را بر رسول خود (نازل کرد اذْکُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَیْکُمْ إِذْ جَاءتْکُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَیْهِمْ رِیحًا وَجُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا».
9.en: Gabriel (PBUH) descended upon the Prophet (PBUH) and said, "O Muhammad! Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, has answered your prayer." The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) knelt on his knees, spread his hands, and tears flowed from his eyes. Then he cried out, "Gratitude, gratitude, for You have sheltered me and sheltered those who are with me." Then Gabriel (PBUH) said, "O Messenger of Allah, Allah has granted you victory and has sent against them a wind from the sky containing pebbles, and a wind from the fourth heaven containing stones." Hudhayfah said: "The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) sent me to bring him news of them. I went out and found that the fires of the people had been extinguished and died down. The first of Allah’s soldiers arrived—a fierce wind containing pebbles—which left no fire without extinguishing it, and no tent without casting it down, {and no spear without casting it aside}, until they began to shield themselves from the pebbles. I could hear the sound of the pebbles striking their shields. Then the greater army of Allah arrived. Abu Sufyan went to his mount and shouted to the Quraysh, 'Escape! Escape!' Then Uyaynah ibn Hisn did the same, and al-Harith ibn Awf did the same, and the confederates (al-Ahzab) departed. Hudhayfah returned to the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) and informed him of the news. Then Allah—the Almighty, whose greatness is manifest—revealed to His Messenger: 'Remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to you, so We sent upon them a wind and armies you did not see.'"
